question: If a certain sum of money becomes double of itself in 8 years 6 months at simple interest, then what will be the annual rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Sum of money

Amount (A) = 2 × Principal (2P)

Time (T) = 8 years 6 months = 8.5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100
